description: This file contains manual testing utilities for the Mattermost server, including functions to set up test environments, create users and teams, and perform specific manual tests such as auto-linking. It defines a TestEnvironment struct, a ManualTest function that handles test setup and execution, and a helper function getChannelID.

classes.name: TestEnvironment
classes.description: A helper struct used for setting up test parameters, including client, team and user IDs, context, and HTTP request/response objects.

methods.name: ManualTest
methods.description: Main function to handle manual testing commands, setup test environment, create users and teams, and execute specific tests based on URL parameters.

methods.name: getChannelID
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve a channel ID by name within a team for a given app context.
